newsitem.title: CHINA: Everbright Int'l places shares to parent.
newsitem.headline: Everbright Int'l places shares to parent.

text.p: China Everbright International Ltd has placed 53.45 million shares to a wholly-owned subsidiary of its parent, China Everbright Holdings Ltd, to pay for two properties acquired from the parent, a company statement said.
"The property comprises two office units ...in a high quality commercial building completed in 1982," said the company said in an announcement published on Monday.

The total gross floor area of 7,015 sq ft in the Far East Finance Centre near Hong Kong's Central business district was valued at HK$115 million and sold to Everbright International for HK$112.24 million, it said.
The new shares were issued at a price of HK$2.10 each, which was about equal to the average traded price of the shares for the 30 days prior to the sales agreement, the company said.
It also represented a discount of 49.7 percent to the closing price of HK$4.225 per share on July 3, immediately prior to the signing of the agreement on July 4, the statement said.
Parent China Everbright Holdings Ltd held 62.26 percent or 995.39 million shares prior to the agreement.
The purchase of the new shares, which represent 3.34 percent of the existing issue capital of the company, will raise the parent's stake to 63.48 percent of the enlarged issued capital.
